It sounds like you’re feeling really drained and like you don’t have enough space for yourself right now. Wanting to live alone can come from a need for peace, independence, and control over your own life—that’s a very human feeling. 
 
If moving out isn’t possible at the moment, it might help to create small “alone spaces” for yourself within your current situation—time when you can rest, reset, and do things just for you. Even short moments of privacy can make a difference over time. 
 
If these feelings of exhaustion and wanting to escape your current situation stay strong, it could also help to talk with someone you trust about it, so you’re not carrying everything by yourself. 
 
You deserve calm, comfort, and a life that feels balanced for you 💚
